theme_and_art_direction.description: An award-worthy (Awwwards level) distinctive art direction focusing on calm, healing, and hope. It blends editorial elegance with modern SaaS functionality. The design avoids the generic 'medical' or 'AI-slop' look, instead favoring warm sands, sage greens, tactile surfaces, and generous negative space to reduce cognitive load and evoke a sense of safety.

headings.usage: Used for all major headings (H1, H2, H3) and the kinetic hero. Provides an elegant, humanistic, and editorial feel.

body.usage: Used for all body text, dashboard data, and UI elements. Clean, modern, and highly legible.

rules: Light theme is enforced as the primary experience to evoke daytime, clarity, and hope.
Color is functional: primary sage green used sparingly for active states, CTAs, and progress.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background with a delicate 1px border (border-black/5) and a very soft ambient shadow (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]).
surfaces.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers. bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5. NEVER use completely transparent headers.
surfaces.neumorphism_tactile: For daily journal mood buttons or small dashboard widgets, soft inner shadows to indicate pressed states.

borders_and_radii.radius: Large, soft corners. rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for major cards to evoke safety.

marketing_page.strategy: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) with aggressive asymmetry.
marketing_page.hero: Large kinetic typography. Full height or 80vh. Subdued abstract sand/fog background image treated deliberately (clipped frame or soft overlay).
marketing_page.manifesto: Numbered chapters using a bento grid but with wide gaps (gap-12 or gap-16). Very generous padding (py-24 or py-32).
marketing_page.marquee: Slow editorial marquee, low contrast. react-fast-marquee with Serif font. Text: 'RESPIRĂ • VINDECĂ-TE • TRĂIEȘTE •'.

dashboard_shell.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B), but softened with generous padding inside cards.
dashboard_shell.main_content: Dashboard grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Top-left widget is the Sobriety Tracker (dominant visual).

widgets.sobriety_tracker: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 row-span-1. Large elegant number for days sober.
widgets.ai_chat: Clean chat interface, soft bubbles, no harsh borders.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal on-load. Wrapper overflow-hidden, child initial={{ y: '100%' }} animate={{ y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}.
motion.scroll_animations: Framer motion whileInView with staggered children viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}. Gentle fade up (y: 30, opacity: 0).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
motion.lenis: Mandatory for smooth momentum scrolling on the marketing page to give a premium feel.

3d_libraries.usage: Use a subtle 3D float or parallax effect on the hero image (abstract sand or fog) to create a 'signature on-load moment' without overwhelming the user. Avoid complex WebGL scenes as they might distract from the calming purpose.

shadcn_customization: Override default Shadcn styles to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Increase border-radius to rounded-2xl.
Remove hard black borders on inputs, use soft gray borders that turn sage green on focus (focus:ring-primary).
Use Shadcn Card, Button, Input, Dialog for the dashboard, heavily customized for the earthy palette.

icons.style: Lightweight, consistent stroke width (1.5px). NEVER use emojis as icons.

hero_background.description: Abstract smooth sand dune. Use with a very soft overlay (bg-white/40) to ensure text readability.

manifesto_images.description: Foggy lake. Use in a clipped frame (e.g., a tall arched image or strict rectangle with border-radius) next to text.

dashboard_welcome.description: Sea under clouds at golden hour. Good for a small welcome banner in the dashboard.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over the hero image has sufficient contrast. If necessary, use a subtle text-shadow or a gradient overlay.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a clear focus state (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid="login-submit-button").
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion animations.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Initialize Tailwind CSS with the provided CSS variables in the globals.css and configure tailwind.config.js to use Cormorant Garamond (serif) and Outfit (sans).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee, sonner.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the Marketing Landing Page in Romanian using .js and .jsx files. Implement the kinetic hero with a line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion. Add the editorial marquee and the numbered manifesto chapters in a bento-style asymmetrical grid.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build the Dashboard Shell. Create a collapsible sidebar navigation. Ensure the layout is a dense but calm grid. Implement the Sobriety Tracker, Daily Journal, AI Chat, and Community widgets.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Apply 'Godly' level polish: ensure no fully transparent headers (use glassmorphism), verify generous padding throughout (p-8, py-24), and add hover/active micro-interactions to all buttons and cards.

ui_ux_principles: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadows.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky/floating elements.
NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
NEVER apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container text globally.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
No complete transparent background in header. Always use a solid color or glassmorphism.
For Romanian language, ensure diacritics (ă, â, î, ș, ț) render correctly with the chosen fonts.
